//RequiresDuplicateDetection: Left OFF deliberately, even though this exercise is about idempotency.
Broker-side duplicate detection drops a message whose MessageId was seen in
the last 20 seconds — it protects against a publisher retrying a send, and
nothing else. It does NOT protect against the case that actually matters: a
consumer that did the work and died before settling, whose message is then
redelivered minutes later. Only the consumer can defend against that, which is
why dedupe lives in the handler. Turning this on would mask the behaviour

Subscriptions.//: Subscription 1 of 2. No Rules, so it receives EVERY message published to the topic — the fan-out this exercise is about.
Subscriptions.Name: audit
